Subject: Quick demo — coordinating times across US/EU/APAC this week

Hi Neha / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday — BrightWave is excited to see Redwood's latency/cost storytelling for multi-region traffic. We'd like to schedule a 45-minute demo this week that includes our product team in SF (US-PST), two engineers in Berlin (CET), and our PM in Sydney (AEDT).

Heads up: our Berlin folks are switching to winter time on Nov 2 and the US DST change is the following week (your team mentioned there may be overlapping weeks where the offsets are unusual). Can you propose a couple of slots that work for Redwood and confirm which timezone you want us to use when we accept?

I've attached a short mutual action plan and a proposed calendar with tentative slots — feel free to edit.

Subject: Re: Quick demo — coordinating times across US/EU/APAC this week

Hi Leah — thanks for the attachments, they were helpful.

Short answer: we can do a 45-minute session but want to avoid the odd hour where CET/US/PST offsets flip. Two pragmatic options that usually work for tri-zone demos:

- Option A (early US / late EU): 08:00 PST / 16:00 CET / 02:00 AEDT (next day) — best if Sydney can join asynchronously.
- Option B (late US / morning EU): 11:00 PST / 19:00 CET / 05:00 AEDT (next day) — better for live participation in EU+US, tough for APAC.

We prefer Option B if Sydney can accept a later-day session; otherwise Option A and we can record for APAC.

Quick clarification: our calendar invites should use UTC as the canonical timezone when sending so participants' clients handle DST transitions correctly. Can you confirm participant cities (SF / Berlin / Sydney) and whether anyone must be in-office (which could shift local availability)?

I'll hold both slots tentatively on Redwood's side and loop Soojin to set the final invite once we hear participant confirm.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Thanks Neha — confirmed cities: San Francisco (US/PST), Berlin (DE/CET), Sydney (AU/AEDT). No one is required to be in office.

On the DST note: Berlin switched on Nov 2 to CET (UTC+1). Our Sydney PM is flexible but prefers not to be earlier than 05:00 AEDT. Given that, Option B (11:00 PST / 19:00 CET / 05:00 AEDT) is borderline but acceptable if we can start promptly and keep to 45 minutes.

I've updated proposed_slots.ics with both Option A and Option B and added a column 'Preferred' next to Option B. Also attaching a one-page agenda in case Redwood wants to tailor it.

Attachment: agenda_one_pager.pdf (application/pdf, 22 KB)

Would you be able to send the final invite in UTC and include a note about recording for APAC? Also, can Redwood confirm which model variants you'll demo (we care about throughput on 8k vs 32k contexts)? Happy to include Tom (engineering) on the session.

-Leah
